market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$101-105 on May 4, with peak at $107 already this month. Strait of Hormuz tensions, 9.1 mbpd Persian Gulf supply disruption, and Iranian missile activity create strong upside risk. Hitting $110 (3-9% above current) anytime in May is fairly likely given volatility regime. Estimate ~65%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Diplomatic resolution could cap prices; depends on geopolitics evolution
